name: bosque
promptText: Dense forest interior with a winding dirt path receding to a central vanishing point, eye-level centered camera, multiple receding planes of tree trunks and varied undergrowth, large foreground trees flanking the path and leafy canopy overhead. Rendered in the exact warm painterly style of references 'loma' and 'casa de campo': high-key natural daylight with soft shadows and medium contrast (no harsh B&W), palette of warm sandy ochre for the dirt path, golden-yellow and sage greens for fields and foliage, olive and muted greens for trees, stone greys for rocks, soft sky blue and creamy cloud whites, subtle canvas texture and visible brushwork, highly detailed foreground flora (ferns, grasses, small white flowers) and scattered grey stones, slightly impressionistic yet naturalistic, matching the color grading, lighting and detail density of loma and casa de campo. Preserve large clear central path and upper canopy zones for characters and lettering, borderless, immersive.
